title: Q-LIFT-flowbalance: lift the FLOW-BALANCE-1 JS twin into workers core
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** FLOW-BALANCE-1; the session's GitHub App could not write to ultrastable/workers (git push over the session proxy: 403; GitHub App create ref: 403 Resource not accessible by integration, 2026-11-21)
**Done check:** cmd:gh api repos/ultrastable/workers/contents/core/flowbalance/index.js --jq .name
**Status:** closed

Lift `seed/worker/src/flowbalance.js` into ultrastable/workers as `core/flowbalance/index.js`, with `seed/worker/test/flowbalance.test.js` as `core/flowbalance/flowbalance.test.js` (import path `./index.js`), through the cross-repo lane (EXEC-X, FLEET_TOKEN). Then the workers copy is the one tenants vendor.

size: S

**Closing probe:** the file exists on workers main.

**Progress:** 2026-11-21 the lift is in this repository's core copy, workers/core/flowbalance/index.js with flowbalance.test.js (5/5 pass). Writing to ultrastable/workers was refused again on every surface this session had: git push 403, REST create ref 403 (write path not permitted through the proxy), GitHub MCP create_branch 403 Resource not accessible by integration. The item stays open on its probe until the cross-repo lane (FLEET_TOKEN) copies it (session_0156nqDte8FeqRLjvGRAAb6w).

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-21T19:41:38Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 2 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: ValueError: reply is neither JSON nor FILE or EDIT blocks. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
